title: Harness Foundation Improvements Implementation Tasks
principles: Preserve HE-001 through HE-004 and convert the accepted planning input into schema-valid audit and crosswalk records before dependent corrections begin.
Migrate only the six complete canonical skill folders, two TaxKit repository-profile overlays, exact relative Claude links, and explicitly declared local extras.
Keep repository-local skills usable from a clean clone without a user-specific or global filesystem dependency at runtime.
Adapt the governance contract to TaxKit's current owners and Effect-native tooling instead of re-rendering the repository from a Site-style scaffold.
Preserve HGI-203 through HGI-205 release proof, runbooks, authority, controls, and CI graph unless a separately accepted dependency names an exact correction.
Qualify a new epoch only after the final migrated state, normal verification, five retained journeys, and fresh independent review pass.
Keep local, Git, hosted CI, registry, deployment, provider, public-site, and external-consumer claims separate.

globalVerification.commitPolicy: Create an active execution plan when HFI-001 begins. A per-run authority receipt is required before commit; push, versioning, release, publication, deployment, provider access, and recovery remain out of scope.

Each task and final epoch identify rollback/recovery, retained evidence, last-known-good identity, stop conditions, and separate external non-claims.
